data_records.name: Dated business lead records
data_records.log_policy: Do not emit full lead rows or credentials into CI logs; operational metrics only.
data_records.ai_access: No runtime AI access; development AI must not receive secrets.
data_records.retention: Retained as dated business lead records until an authorized VSN retention/deletion decision changes policy.
data_records.deletion_method: Authorized workbook/row deletion in Google Drive/Sheets when required.
data_records.backup_policy: Google-hosted workbook durability; no lower-environment raw production copy.

data_records.name: R2 permanent duplicate fingerprints
data_records.log_policy: Only compact counts/object keys; never raw source values.
data_records.ai_access: No raw lead values are stored in the fingerprint keyspace.
data_records.retention: Permanent accepted-history dedupe fingerprints unless an authorized migration/deletion changes policy.
data_records.backup_policy: Objects-v1 read compatibility plus pending-marker crash reconciliation.
data_records.non_production_policy: Use isolated smoke prefixes/transactions; do not clone raw production leads.

data_records.name: Google/R2/GitHub credentials
data_records.retention: Provider/operational lifetime with rotation or revocation on exposure/account change.
data_records.deletion_method: Revoke/delete in provider and GitHub secrets.
data_records.backup_policy: Do not back up into repository, PM, logs or AI memory.
data_records.non_production_policy: No secret injection into untrusted PR execution.

data_records.name: Operational health/yield telemetry
data_records.log_policy: Metrics/incident summaries only; redact sensitive data.
data_records.ai_access: Authorized development AI may inspect repository/runtime evidence without secrets.
data_records.retention: Operational history retained until an authorized lifecycle policy changes.
data_records.backup_policy: Provider durability plus reproducible telemetry schema in repository.
data_records.non_production_policy: Synthetic/test telemetry should use isolated stores or mocks.

data_records.name: SaaS draft validation handoffs
data_records.log_policy: Never log submitted values, draft nonces, CSRF/session cookies or error payloads.
data_records.retention: Read deadline five minutes, maximum three entries per session; expired entries pruned on subsequent writes. Physical rows follow Django session expiry and operator clearsessions cleanup; production retention/cleanup acceptance remains open.
data_records.deletion_method: Logout session flush, bounded eviction/pruning and existing expired-session cleanup.
data_records.backup_policy: No new backup mechanism; production session-store backup/retention review remains open.
data_records.non_production_policy: Only disposable synthetic sessions and search fixtures.

data_records.name: SaaS redacted candidate event evidence
data_records.log_policy: Do not log candidate payloads, signatures, verifier keys, cookies or source record references. Routine output uses compact counts/status only.
data_records.retention: Candidate eligibility expires at the recorded source-derived deadline; this does not erase audit metadata. Operator-approved audit metadata retention and physical cleanup must be defined/verified before production activation. No production payload intake is enabled.
data_records.deletion_method: No automated cleanup activated. Evidence/parent links and migration reverse guard require an explicit preservation/reconciliation plan for destructive changes.
data_records.backup_policy: No new backup mechanism or production store enabled; audit metadata encryption, expiry and restore acceptance remain open.
data_records.non_production_policy: Disposable synthetic evidence only; no raw production copy. Event references must be opaque provider audit identifiers without personal data.
